The text describes a recent environmental summit focusing on the Paris Agreement and international pledges to reduce carbon emissions. The Paris Agreement was adopted in 2015 and entered into force in 2016, marking a significant shift in global climate policy with universally recognized standards for emission reductions. Therefore, the content is situated in the contemporary period, specifically post-2016.
